reference._why: Plain torch, outside the port package. Written directly against dsv4_ref/kernel.py:328-350 over the reference's single concatenated [window ++ topk] index list (dsv4_ref/model.py:520), while the triad's fallback goes through the family-19 gather-helper composition — two independent spellings of the declared math.

_tolerance_derivation: Identical to mla_decode_tkg.declaration.json (same out dtype, same math class): rtol = 2^-7 = 0.0078125, atol = 2^-10 = 0.0009765625, compared in fp32 after casting both legs. Fixed in the sealed prereg BEFORE any measurement; never widened.
_domain_notes: positions omitted -> pos = arange(T) causal prefill (mla_sparse_attention.py:468-477 at 88b34e7). seq_ids omitted with 3-D caches [1, slots, 512] -> flat single-sequence addressing (_slot_ids falls through to local ids). compress_ratio=0 -> topk indices are raw row ids, -1 = absent, no causal cap on the compressed leg (the indexer owns causality at ratio 0). chunk_size omitted -> single chunk. No current-row operands; no scale caches; no cache write exists in this op at any setting (prefill writes are LD-77, model-level).
_uncovered_by_harness: Graded instead by the committed probe numerics/probe_mla_sparse_attention_cte_supplementary.py (which reads rtol/atol FROM this declaration): 4-D paged fp8 caches with block tables, ue8m0 scale caches, the F-240 current-chunk provenance split (current_kv_rows/current_compressed_rows + writer-frame slot ids), ratio>0 pooling incl. ratio-128 groups closing in-chunk (prefill-side C128 coverage at the kernel rung), swa width splits, and chunked query processing. A recorded harness-vocabulary limit, never an absorbed one.

cases._role: Core CTE math: topk gather with -1 sentinels, sliding-window band with causal edge, ONE softmax over [window ++ topk], per-head sink in the denominator only, fully-masked-query keep factor, 3-D contiguous addressing.
cases._simulator_note: Small dims (T=8, H=2, 8 gathered rows/token). If the deployed simulator rejects an ISA op used by the kernel, the harness records UNCOVERED loudly - never a pass - and the same comparison is carried by the probe legs plus the compile_nki venue (prereg P3/P4).
